component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Visual package manager and dependency hierarchy explorer

description.p: Dendro is a modern, high-performance graphical package manager and visual dependency hierarchy explorer built specifically for Fedora Linux.

ul.li: Native librpm and libdnf5 bindings for sub-millisecond database queries
Intelligent semantic decision engine for deterministic package categorization
Interactive multi-level dependency trees with cycle detection
Two-tier capability resolution caching (L1 RAM + L2 SQLite WAL)
Dry-run transaction simulation and automatic system root pillar protection
Privileged execution with Polkit and live streaming terminal output
DNF transaction history exploration and one-click rollback

screenshot.caption: Main tree view exploring package dependencies and queued operations

description.p: Desktop integration and packaging fix release:

ul.li: Added native scalable vector SVG icon in /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/ for sharp rendering in KDE Plasma Kickoff and GNOME Shell.
Resolved corrupted PNG header issue by rasterizing icons directly from the master SVG during RPM build time.
Sanitized desktop file line endings and updated categories to comply with FreeDesktop standards.
Bundled scalable vector icon in standalone AppImage releases.
Adapted execution footprint for Fedora 42+ unified /usr/bin and /usr/sbin architecture.
Added /usr/libexec inspection to accurately isolate internal daemons and D-Bus backends from interactive CLI tools.
Integrated manual page section analysis (man8 system administration vs man1 user commands).
Expanded automated test suite covering unified binaries and internal helper services.

description.p: The Cognitive Engine Update: Major architectural upgrade introducing intelligent semantic package classification.
Major architectural and performance release featuring native bindings and system protection.
Production release of Dendro package manager for Fedora Linux.
